title: Ex 1.2 #3 · {x ∈ ℝ : x² = 2} × {a, c, e}
prompt: List the elements of $\{x \in \mathbb{R} : x^2 = 2\} \times \{a, c, e\}$ between braces. (Steps may call the two factors $A$ and $B$, in that order.)
answer_format: A set of ordered pairs between braces, like {(1, a), (2, b)}. Spaces are optional. Steps are optional.
hints: First list {x ∈ ℝ : x² = 2}: x² = 2 has two real solutions.
Then pair each element of the first factor with each element of the second: 6 pairs in all.
solution: The first factor is $A = \{- \sqrt{2}, \sqrt{2}\}$ and the second is $B = \{a, c, e\}$.
Pair each element of A with each element of B.
So the answer is $\{(- \sqrt{2}, a), (- \sqrt{2}, c), (- \sqrt{2}, e), (\sqrt{2}, a), (\sqrt{2}, c), (\sqrt{2}, e)\}$.
